title: Module map from a global section
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For $s\in\Gamma(X,M)$ define the $\mathcal O_X$-linear morphism $\mathcal O_X\to M$ by sending $r\in\mathcal O_X(U)$ to $r\,s|_U$ on every open $U\subseteq X$. Equivalently, form the compatible family of restrictions of $s$ and apply the inverse of the unit-Hom/sections equivalence. This definition fixes the map, including on the zero module and on the empty scheme.
